# Historical Windows baseline from the 3.0.55 r9 worktree before the first macOS run.
# The macOS workflow compares names literally and reports platform-specific differences.
Eagle graphite is the default palette with blue selection accent
Eagle graphite remains the first available palette
HTTP endpoint rejects browser origins, unknown peers and invalid message IDs
a version 3 saved copy of the untouched blue default migrates to Eagle graphite
an untouched legacy blue preset migrates to the reference graphite theme
asset folder picker is a separate fixed flyout and detail view hides the overlapping feedback chip
avatar and nickname updates sync via peer profiles while legacy peers stay visible
browser extension declares AI Flow video, two-way folder sync, upload, and manual web-asset links behind the paired bridge
closing the desktop app cancels only unfinished AI Flow transfers and makes reference polling quiet
delete integration keeps the indexed asset and exposes a restore reconciliation path
direct text is private, retries are idempotent, unread counts and history survive restart
discovery advertises chat capabilities and accepts a restarted stable device session
loading a previously saved alternate palette clears it and old custom color history
nested folders render branch and ancestor connectors with a terminating last branch
new saved themes survive reload and invalid values safely normalize
paper theme keeps dark preview, menu, media, and card controls light
read receipts remain queued while the sender is offline and deliver on return
reading a private message returns a durable read receipt to the sender
sidebar category filters use the graphite navigation icons without changing filter behavior
small audio waveform uses a high-contrast blue-gray on its navy card
sync console popup is packaged with a message-only control surface
waveform uses the shared audio and destroys once on cleanup
